title: ChatGPT → Codex Autonomous Dispatch Reconnaissance
summary: 研究 ChatGPT Primary 是否能在不靠 Claire 人工傳話、不額外使用 API billing、不保存個人 ChatGPT refresh credential 的前提下自主 dispatch Codex。結果確認 GitHub 可作 durable state、codex exec 可 non-interactive、Cloud Task 與 exec 的 repo/credential boundary 不同；真正 blocker 是缺少 supported subscription-entitled unattended workload identity / stable Cloud Task invocation。現階段決策為 WAIT / Deferred by Provider Gap。
flow: Primary → Work Order → Claire one-step dispatch → Codex Cloud Task → GitHub evidence → Primary QC. Autonomous path deferred until provider exposes supported subscription-backed unattended identity / task invocation.
